description.text: Civil engineering in the school of highway is a science and technology for designing and constructing various infrastructure such as houses, bridges, tunnels, urban underground space etc. The civil engineering discipline of Chang'an University was established in 1953. It is one of the earliest disciplines of the “211 Project” and “985 Project Advantage Discipline Innovation Platform”, and is also the construction content of "world-class disciplines" and "first-class disciplines in Shaanxi Province". In the early 1980s, geotechnical engineering was one of the earliest disciplines in China to train foreign students in engineering. In 2003, “Structural Engineering” and “Bridge and Tunnel Engineering” received the right to confer doctoral degrees. In 2006, the right to grant a doctoral degree in civil engineering was granted. In 2007, a postdoctoral research station was established. The civil engineering discipline in the school of highway including four secondary disciplines: Bridge Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Tunnel Engineering, Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Engineering. l Bridge Engineering l Geotechnical Engineering l Tunnel Engineering l Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Engineering

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Chang'an University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: On the application system of our university, applicants must fill in information in Chinese or English and submit application materials online.1. Valid Ordinary Passport.If the applicant is in China, a valid residence permit is also required.2. The highest degree certificate. Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation letter as a substitute, and have to bring the original certificate when they come to China.3. Transcripts.4. "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners"(Attachment 3).Applicants should strictly follow the items required in the "Physical Examination Records for Foreigners" and fill them out in Chinese or English. The “Physical Examination Record for Foreigners” missing pages or without a photo or a cross-page seal on it, or without a signature of physician or seal from hospital is invalid. Whereas the inspection results are valid in 6 months, applicants are requested to determine the time of their medical examination accordingly.5. Valid non-criminal record certificate within 6 months. If the applicant is already in China, she/he can only provide performance letter or Non-objection certificate from current university.6. Proof of Language Proficiency.7. Study Plan for Bachelor or Research Plan for Master and PhD.8. Two recommendation letters signed by (associate) professors (Undergraduate students are exempt).9. Conditional acceptance letter (It’s not a mandatory but a preferred file, with which students will be admitted in priority).10. Others preferred: academic achievements (important), certificates of sports or cultural activity.11. Students under 18 years old should upload Letter of Authorization.(Attachment 4)Note: Chinese or English translation copy is mandatory if original file is not in Chinese/English/Spanish.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health.2. Education and age requirements of the applicants:(1) Those pursuing bachelor degree must have a high school diploma and be under 25 years old;(2) Those pursuing master degree must have a bachelor's degree and be under 35 years old;(3) Those pursuing PhD degree must have a master's degree and be under 40 years old;(4) Non-degree program students should be under 45 years old.3. Non-other scholarship recipients.4. Language ability requirements:DegreeMediumLanguage RequirementsMaster & PhDChineseHSK5 ≥ 180(To apply for Humanity School majors needs HSK5 ≥ 210)EnglishIELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥80, Duolingo≥100BachelorChineseHSK4 ≥ 180(To apply for Humanity School majors needs HSK5 ≥ 180)EnglishIELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥80, Duolingo≥100Note:Applicants providing Chinese or English medium of instruction certificate are exempted from submitting corresponding certificate of language proficiency.
